hypothesis: Measured component proposals and association continue when rail geometry is unavailable, without any intersection claim or fabricated rail coordinates.

criterion.availability: Segmentation and association execute on every real invalid-geometry frame; inspect component support and neighboring-frame identity, not just counts.
criterion.safety: Invalid frames remain unknown/unavailable; objects have unknown path relation, no confirmed intersection, and null rail-relative coordinates.
criterion.control: Preserve valid-frame geometric inference; report altered tracking history separately.
criterion.limits: No synthetic scenes, no detector-derived ground truth; report merging and unsupported proposal workload.
